articles.title_en: Russia and Ukraine Trade Deadly Strikes as Oleshky Ceasefire Begins
articles.lead_en: At least two people were killed in Ukrainian attacks in western Russia, regional officials said, while strikes against Kyiv left one person dead.

articles.title_en: Ceasefire takes effect in Russian-occupied Oleshky amid humanitarian catastrophe
articles.lead_en: The truce that Russia and Ukraine agreed to for the evacuation of civilians and delivery of humanitarian aid has begun in Oleshky, in the Kherson region.

articles.title_en: Two killed, 17 injured in Ukrainian drone and missile strikes on Russia’s Voronezh, regional governor says
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian forces struck Voronezh with missiles and drones overnight on October 26.

articles.title_en: Freight train derails near Russia’s Yekaterinburg, tanker cars catch fire
articles.lead_en: Twenty cars of a freight train derailed on the Reshety–Sedelnikovo stretch of track in Russia’s Sverdlovsk region, and seven tank cars caught fire, the Russian state news agency TASS reported, citing the Sverdlovsk region branch of Russia’s Emergency Situations Ministry.
